comment: The identical architectures make optimizer recipe the deciding factor. AdamW at 3e-4 provides a moderate nominal progress budget (0.0768), between RMSprop at 0.003 (0.768) and Adam at 3e-5 (0.00768). K1071 supported preferring the moderate recipe over aggressive RMSprop for a width-128 post-LN transformer. K1001 cautioned against mechanically maximizing displacement. C remains a plausible conservative contender, so its loss should not be interpreted as validating a universal minimum-progress threshold. This result supports the scoped recipe preference, not an isolated optimizer or learning-rate law.
